title: Destabilization of ammonia borane via dual confinement in a cobalt-based Prussian blue analogue
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,5227-5235

Maëlle Cahu, Carlos A. Castilla-Martinez, Fabrice Salles, Jérôme Long, Umit B. Demirci
The lacunar CoII[CoIII(CN)6]2/3□1/3 Prussian blue analogue confines ammonia borane (NH3BH3) via a dual mechanism: with chemisorption onto coordinatively unsaturated Co2+ sites and physisorption within the vacancies of the porous structure.
